title: Family plans to sue RCMP over Clayton Willey's death
subtitle: The final chapter is being written in the saga of Clayton Willey.
article: The final chapter is being written in the saga of Clayton Willey.
APTN National News first broke the story back in 2003.
Willey was the Aboriginal man beaten and Tasered repeatedly by RCMP in Prince George, B.C.
He died hours after being taken into custody.
The findings of a formal investigation into Willey's death have just been released.
Willey's family has been waiting nearly a decade for the report.
